design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (sensor_calibration_desk). Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 4]; adas_ext_alignment_comeback_credit takes 5 factors, adas_ext_calibration_acceptance takes 4.

1. Why this is a good test. The customer asks only to accept and pay for a customer-pay camera calibration. The acceptance amount (adas_ext_calibration_acceptance) is the share of a rated calibration quote plus the balance standing on the order, and its rule says it 'is fixed only after the order carries the goodwill write-off owed against its alignment correction charge'. The ledger at 2026-10-06 carries no write-off (a3521a00-da6c-410d-b9ff-6ce65260d0b2 correction charge 77.30 stands unreduced; the only write-off, 10.00, names the check charge - a near-miss for an agent that sees 'a goodwill write-off' and stops), so the agent must read the comeback-credit policy, establish from the claim record (Structural Claim Repair delivered 2026-08-07) and the order (customer_request, opened 2026-09-02) that a credit is owed, compute it (60.23) and book it, and only then compute 327.71. Difficulty comes from reading policy, gathering five record sources and calculating, not from tool guessing: each problem has exactly one target tool.

2. Scope. Difficulty claims four extended policies: task 0 claims adas_ext_alignment_comeback_credit + adas_ext_calibration_acceptance with tools post_comeback_goodwill_credit_c6e84f0b and pay_calibration_acceptance_f9e8bcf7; task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, [4,4]) keeps adas_ext_alignment_check_charge + adas_ext_correction_authorization with post_alignment_check_charge_59500100 and pay_alignment_correction_authorization_61ce2890. Disjoint. Task 0's history is consistent with task 1's two policies (see 6).

3. Problem tree. Root adas_ext_calibration_acceptance (owner=user tool). Edge root -> adas_ext_alignment_comeback_credit, kind value_input, gate write_offs, form state. Prerequisite sentence: 'The amount a customer pays to accept a calibration is fixed only after the order carries the goodwill write-off owed against its alignment correction charge.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (a goodwill write-off entry against the correction charge, as find_adas_ledger shows it); no tool/id/code token; strength 'only after', scope the write-off owed. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a goodwill write-off against an alignment correction charge: the comeback credit tool (the other three tools book a check charge or customer payments). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no write-off) + comeback-credit rule ('booked as a goodwill write-off against the alignment correction charge on the day that charge posts') -> book the comeback credit. False at opening: adas_ledger has rows 6bc4e5a0-72ed-4c7b-bfa5-2799ef0f02a4 (check charge 43.16), 231cc3e0-c90f-44e1-9a15-40507b73d39d (goodwill 10.00 against the check charge), 06c5ee25-dc94-4ef0-b30a-142fe6cc5e81 (payment 110.46), a3521a00-da6c-410d-b9ff-6ce65260d0b2 (correction 77.30), and no write-off against the correction charge. Topological order: comeback credit (step 10) then acceptance (step 12). Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 10 gives acceptance 387.94 instead of 327.71 and leaves no write-off row. The customer is the payer of the root problem; the agent unlocks and hands over the tool at step 11.

4. Factor card - comeback credit (60.23; baseline_result 9.28):
 - window_end (method; tiers: order opened on the customer's own request -> opening date; opened on a network customer-pay repair -> first alignment check; opened on a glass replacement or any other customer-pay source -> latest out-of-spec check, each tier reachable by a customer-pay order carrying a correction charge): this order was opened on the customer's own request -> window ends 2026-09-02 (26 days after delivery); baseline end = latest out-of-spec check 2026-09-14 (38 days, the treatment a glass-replacement order receives) -> 42.16.
 - window_share (parameter, claim): 26 <= 30 -> 0.50; baseline 0.20 -> 24.09.
 - repair_class_weight (parameter, claim): Structural Claim Repair -> 1.0; baseline 0.60 -> 36.14.
 - comeback_cap (parameter, multi-source: class AND window): structural and <= 90 days -> 2 x 45.00 = 90.00, less 10.00 goodwill already = 80.00; baseline 45.00 less 10.00 = 35.00 -> 35.00. Declared overwrite of the base goodwill cap sentence of adas_evt_settlement.
 - credit_base (method): check 1 out of spec and corrected at that visit -> 77.30 + 43.16 = 120.46; baseline correction alone -> 38.65.
 Result min(120.46 x 0.50 x 1.0, 90.00 - 10.00, 77.30) = 60.23.
 Factor card - acceptance (327.71; baseline_result 164.27):
 - acceptance_share (parameter, estimate): no-show booking 63bf3568-5fc6-429d-b434-837ef32b0cbf closed 2026-03-16, 170 days before the record date -> 1.0; baseline 0.5 -> 133.74.
 - record_date (method): customer_request order -> record date = opening 2026-09-02; baseline = acceptance day (204 days -> 0.75) -> 0.75 x 387.94 - 60.23 = 230.725 -> 230.73 (half up). Near-miss: measured to today the no-show is outside 183 days.
 - calibration_returning_rate (parameter, claim): structural repair delivered 60 days ago -> 0.90; baseline 1 -> 370.81.
 - calibration_member_rate (parameter, warranty): Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty fdfcac38-55f1-4d2b-a808-df4ec58a6794 active, issued 60 days ago -> 0.96; baseline 1 -> 343.87.
 Quote round(449.00 x 0.90 x 0.96) = 387.94; balance 120.46 - 70.23 - 110.46 = -60.23; amount 327.71. Declared overwrites: payer-approval acceptance clause, in-house calibration charge clause (charge posts at the accepted quote), settlement-on-completion clause.

5. Base-invariant card. Subjects adas_no_charge and adas_payment are governed only by adas_evt_settlement, which has no eligibility gates (policy_scope): write-offs name the charge they reduce and never exceed it (60.23 <= 77.30); payments use an accepted method (card). No time gates apply to either write.

6. World. Customer b0968787-a1a4-4953-97e2-d2779c068d6e (Corinne Pemberton); vehicle d1d767c4-f40d-46d6-bb01-590bbafa0d09 2022 Subaru Outback, forward_camera only (the rear structural claim repair needed no calibration order); claim repair bf7057c0-880e-4a73-a2f3-c38e3c66ff21 closed, delivered 2026-08-07; warranty fdfcac38-55f1-4d2b-a808-df4ec58a6794; estimate booking 63bf3568-5fc6-429d-b434-837ef32b0cbf no_show closed 2026-03-16; order f279e5a2-de26-44bb-92f1-0e9b7a090947 Dual-Mode Camera Calibration, prechecked 2026-09-14. History reproduces task 1's policies on the world of 2026-09-14: alignment check charge 43.16 (1 check billed, 59.95 x 0.80 x 0.90), a 10.00 goodwill write-off against it the same day, authorization payment 110.46 (rated correction 110.46 less the check standing 33.16 = quote 77.30, share 1.0 because the no-show was 182 days old, plus unpaid check 33.16), correction charge 77.30. Nothing else is owed: no other credit applies, the acceptance is on request. The insurer profile of the claim repair is not seeded (insurer_customer_id null) because no read reaches it.

7. Business-object card. Target: order f279e5a2-de26-44bb-92f1-0e9b7a090947; the write-off names correction charge a3521a00-da6c-410d-b9ff-6ce65260d0b2; the check charge 6bc4e5a0-72ed-4c7b-bfa5-2799ef0f02a4 is only part of the amount figured on, and the existing goodwill 231cc3e0-c90f-44e1-9a15-40507b73d39d against it is not the object of this credit (it only lowers the cap remaining). The payment attaches to the same order. No other order, transfer or write-off exists.

8. Persona. Brisk teacher; volunteers only the goal (accept and pay by card today); gives name, email, PIN when asked, ZIP only if needed; leaves the amount to the agent; agrees passively if told something must be recorded first; pays the stated amount by card through the handed-over tool, then says goodbye. Never mentions claim, warranty, no-show or credit (no_user_hint). No amount is disclosed.

9. Standard solution: find_customers(name) -> verify (email+PIN) -> find_vehicles -> find_adas_orders -> find_adas_events -> find_adas_ledger -> find_claim_repairs -> find_warranty_coverages -> find_estimate_bookings -> unlock/call post_comeback_goodwill_credit_c6e84f0b(order, a3521a00-da6c-410d-b9ff-6ce65260d0b2, 60.23) -> unlock_user/call_user pay_calibration_acceptance_f9e8bcf7(order, 327.71, card).

10. Verification: values recomputed with check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time worlds (authoring script in /tmp, deleted after use); gates run: check_compute --task 0 COMPUTE OK; replay_tasks --task 0 REPLAY OK (after nulling empty references and adding the vehicle read); check_solvability --task 0 SOLVABILITY OK. Revision log: (d) audit round 1 (policy-task audit): T0-1/F-4 - the window-end ladder's fall-through now names glass-replacement orders (the only other customer-pay source that can carry a correction charge) and customer-pay repairs alone take the first-check tier, so all three tiers and the baseline are reachable; gold unchanged (this order sits on tier 1). T0-2 - every rounding to the cent in the charter now states half up and compute adds a 0.000001 guard before RND so the float evaluator rounds a half cent up as the rule says; the record_date sensitivity figure is 230.73 (was 230.72); gold and the other figures unchanged. Charter-wide F-1 (credit base tier 2 now any correction on a later check), F-2 (check charge counts the checks recorded when it is posted and anchors its day counts on that day), F-3 (correction quote never below zero) and O-4 (other goodwill keeps the authority cap) were fixed in the charter; none moves a value in this world: the first check here was out of spec and corrected (tier 1), the 2026-09-14 history charge was posted on its own due day with both checks recorded, and the history quote 77.30 is positive. (c) history_rows of the first world was 7 (< suite maximum 8 needed); added a 10.00 goodwill write-off against the check charge on 2026-09-14 (a near-miss write-off on the wrong charge), recomputed history (quote 77.30) and gold (60.23, 327.71). (a) first world dated the alignment visit 2026-09-28, giving an authorization payment of 93.635 at a half cent -> moved the visit to 2026-09-14 (share 1.0, 110.46). (b) replay flagged empty reference fields as dangling and two unread rows -> empty ids set to null, insurer row dropped, find_vehicles added; computation steps shifted to 10 and 12.

11. Draft recomputation from visible context: the acceptance rule names the write-off it waits on; the comeback-credit rule's scope, window end, share, weight, cap and base are all readable from order, events, ledger, claim and warranty records; the same figures 60.23 and 327.71 follow.
user_scenario: You are Corinne Pemberton, 46, a high-school chemistry teacher in Columbus, Ohio, calling Crestline Collision & Glass on a free period between classes. You are organised and a little brisk, and you like to get things settled in one call. Back in early September the EyeSight warning on your 2022 Subaru Outback kept flashing, so you asked Crestline to look at the camera, and in mid-September they checked and corrected the wheel alignment and did the preliminary checks. The center told you the calibration itself is ready to go once you give the go-ahead and pay. You are calling today to accept the camera calibration on your Outback and pay for it now, by card, so it can be booked in; you want it done, not just a price. You open by saying you want to go ahead with the camera calibration on your Subaru and pay for it today. You give your name, Corinne Pemberton, when the agent asks who is calling. When the agent asks you to confirm your identity you give your email, corinne.pemberton@outlook.com, and your account PIN, 4618; you do not offer your phone number or ZIP unless the agent says those two did not work, in which case your ZIP is 43214. If asked about the car, it is a 2022 Subaru Outback Limited, VIN 4S4BTANC5N3416208. You do not know what the calibration costs after everything on your account and you have no figure in mind; you leave the amount to the agent. If the agent explains that something has to be recorded or adjusted on your order before the amount can be given, you say that is fine and let them do it, without asking for details. Once the agent tells you the amount and hands you the payment step, you pay that exact amount by card yourself, and if asked how you are paying you say card. After the payment goes through you thank the agent briefly and say goodbye; you do not ask for anything else. You never mention your old insurance claim, any warranty, any missed appointment or any credit unless the agent asks you directly, and then you only confirm what the agent reads to you.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with the two credentials she states (email and PIN).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No business may be transacted on the account before identity is verified; two matching credentials are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the vehicle on file: 2022 Subaru Outback Limited, forward camera package, VIN 4S4BTANC5N3416208.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The vehicle reference number ties the calibration order to the claim repair, the warranty coverage and the estimate booking read next; the camera-only package explains why the earlier repair carried no calibration.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her calibration orders: the Dual-Mode Camera Calibration order on the Outback, its tier, source (customer_request), payer (customer_pay), status prechecked and opening date 2026-09-02.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes the calibration price and goodwill authority; the source and opening date decide where the comeback window ends and the record date the no-show is measured to.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The correction charge entry is the charge the comeback credit reduces; the charges, payments and write-offs, and the absence of any write-off against the correction charge, show the prerequisite is unmet and give the balance standing for the acceptance amount.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The delivery date and structural class decide whether a comeback credit is owed, its window share, class weight and cap, and the returning-customer rate on the calibration price.

edges.condition: Where a comeback credit is owed on the order, its calibration money history carries the goodwill write-off against the alignment correction charge for that credit.
edges.policy_source: The amount a customer pays to accept a calibration is fixed only after the order carries the goodwill write-off owed against its alignment correction charge.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: A comeback credit is owed (Structural Claim Repair delivered 2026-08-07, 26 days before the order opened on the customer's request, and the order carries an alignment correction charge), but the order's money history carries no goodwill write-off against that correction charge (its only write-off, 10.00, names the alignment check charge).
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The call at step 10 books a goodwill write-off of 60.23 against the correction charge; the write-offs read by the acceptance computation rise from 10.00 to 70.23 and the balance standing falls from 0.00 to -60.23.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain of two problems: the acceptance waits on the goodwill write-off by its prerequisite sentence, so the write-off is booked first; there are no parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the comeback credit leaves write-offs 10.00 and balance 0.00, so the acceptance amount becomes 387.94 instead of 327.71, and the terminal ledger lacks the 60.23 goodwill write-off against the correction charge.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to accept and pay for the camera calibration; it never mentions a comeback, a credit, a write-off, the insurance claim or the warranty, and says she mentions those only to confirm what the agent reads to her. Her only reaction about an adjustment is conditional on the agent explaining one first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_calibration_acceptance_f9e8bcf7 creates the payment row from its arguments without reading any write-off; post_comeback_goodwill_credit_c6e84f0b creates the write-off without checking dates or classes; neither returns an error for business reasons (task_tools.py).

seed_consistency.check: A forward camera alone with the manufacturer procedure static_and_dynamic takes Dual-Mode Camera Calibration; the vehicle's adas_package is forward_camera; a customer request is paid by the customer (customer_pay); status prechecked with precheck_date 2026-09-14 matches an in-spec check made that day.

Check 1 on 2026-09-14 found the alignment out of spec; it was corrected at that visit after the customer's authorization payment that day, as the precheck rule requires an out-of-spec check to be corrected and checked again.
Check 2, the re-check after the correction, is in spec on the precheck date, so the alignment requirement held at the precheck (0 days, within the 30-day validity).

Alignment check charge 43.16 posted 2026-09-14, the day of the first out-of-spec check: one check billed (2 checks less 1 correction) at 59.95 x 0.80 (structural repair delivered 38 days before) x 1 x 0.90 (lifetime warranty issued 38 days before) = 43.164 -> 43.16.
Goodwill write-off of 10.00 on 2026-09-14 names the alignment check charge it reduces and does not exceed it, well within the Dual-Mode goodwill authority of 45.00.

Authorization payment 110.46 by card on 2026-09-14: rated correction round(129.95 x 0.85) = 110.46; the check charge standing 33.16 (43.16 less the 10.00 goodwill) applied in full (authorized the same day), quote 77.30; share 1.0 (no-show closed 182 days before); plus the unpaid check charge 33.16 = 110.46.
Correction charge 77.30 posted on the day of the correction, equal to the correction quote the customer authorized; check 43.16 less goodwill 10.00 plus correction 77.30 = 110.46, fully paid.
